topic.title: Variable Swap Practice
topic.description: A classic beginner exercise that swaps the values of two variables using a temporary variable. Builds understanding of assignment and memory.

learningNotes.whatILearned: How assignment works in Python and why a temporary variable is needed for swapping values.
learningNotes.challenges: Understanding why direct swap (a = b; b = a) fails without a temp variable.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Learn Python tuple unpacking: a, b = b, a.

files.description: Swaps two variables using a temporary variable.
